name: Baltimore County, MD
findings: Baltimore County has 3,475 nonprofit organizations. 1,437 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,173 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Baltimore County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
